title: Abatuuze mu Nsuku Ebbiri
intro: Mu nsi omuli emikisa mingi, edda ekitundu ekimu kyanyumirwanga ensuku bbiri ez’ekitalo. Obulamu bwabwe bwali bujulizi bwa kusiimibwa Katonda, naye ate emboozi yaabwe yakyuka okwebaza bwe kwakendeera, ekyaviirako enkyukakyuka eyandifuuse akabonero ak’olubeerera eri bonna abafumiitiriza.
clues: Twali bantu abaweereddwa omukisa n’ensi ey’obwangu n’obungi.
Mukama waffe yatuwa ensuku bbiri ezirabika obulungi, nga zijjudde ebibala era nga zirimu ebibala ku buli ludda.
Twalagirwa okusiima, naye twalonda obutasiima ne tukyuka.
Ebbibiro eddene lyaziyiza amazzi agaali gawa ettaka lyaffe obulamu.
Bwe twanywerera ku bikolwa byaffe ebikyamu, ebbibiro lyakutuka era amazzi amataba ne gakulukuta.
Ensuku zaffe edda ezaali zijjudde ebibala byakyusibwamu ebibala ebikaawa, entangawuuzi, n’emiti gya lote mitono.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
